summary: Iter242 — full end-to-end re-verification of the BOT financial governance pipeline (Phase A + B). 21/21 backend pytest assertions PASS. Verified independently: (1) Bot ALWAYS pends financial actions (invoice/payment/expense/reverse) with full echo-back (النوع/الطرف/المبلغ/الأثر المحاسبي + red-line 'لن يُثبَّت أي قيد مالي دون اعتماد بشري مختلف'). (2) Principle ① ask-not-guess: missing amount → clarify (no approval, no guess); unknown customer → clarify. (3) Four-Eyes ENFORCED: same proposer (مدير→مدير) gets 403 four_eyes_violation; different approver (احمد1, supervisor) commits the draft. (4) After approval the accounting_engine posts balanced JEs (verified 320 invoice, 800 expense, 13 SAR reverse target — all balanced dr=cr, sources correct, transaction_type set). (5) Bot reverse via chat creates a contra entry with source='reversal' and reference_id='reversal::<orig>' while preserving the ORIGINAL JE. (6) SITE REST regression intact: /api/finance-actions/invoice|expense work for admin JWT (with field 'customer'+'total' for invoice, 'amount' for expense), technician reverse 403, no-JWT 403, spoofed x-user-role IGNORED, login deny-unknown 401. (7) Safe entity actions (customer/vehicle) still auto-commit (Phase C intentionally NOT yet implemented). (8) Accounting integrity: spot-check across 50 recent journal_entries — all balanced (debit==credit). Frontend smoke test confirms iter241 JWT regression is RESOLVED — login as مدير now POSTs /api/auth/login, stores access_token in localStorage (length 213) and sets httpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies; backend write paths reachable from UI.

minor.issue: Route accepts 'customer'+'total' (not 'amount'). Inconsistent with /expense which uses 'amount'. Returns 400 invalid_amount if only 'amount' provided. Consider normalizing the field name across financial routes.

Top-level executed payload only includes {status, action, entity_id} but NOT approval_id — clients must dig into cards[].data.approval_id. Recommend mirroring approval_id into executed for easier consumption.

action_items: (MINOR) Mirror approval_id into the chat response 'executed' object so clients don't have to parse cards[].
(MINOR) Consider accepting both 'amount' and 'total' on /api/finance-actions/invoice for consistency with /expense and /payment.
(NOTE) Phase C (Level-1 quick confirm for safe entity actions) is intentionally not implemented this round — customer/vehicle create still auto-commits as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ core/unified_executor.py RISKY_ACTIONS correctly forces ALL financial verbs through the Four-Eyes approval pipeline (never auto-commit, regardless of caller role) — red-line respected.

✅ Principle ① implemented in _resolve_financial_target: missing amount + unknown/ambiguous customer return mode='ask' WITHOUT creating an approval draft (verified end-to-end). No fabricated values observed.

✅ core/assistant_kernel._build_action_chat_response produces a complete echo-back card with النوع/الطرف/المبلغ/الأثر المحاسبي + the red-line statement and emits a fully wired ApprovalCard with endpoint=/api/runtime/approvals/<id>/approve.

✅ Single-writer governance: every bot-approved financial draft commits via core/action_runtime.commit() → core/financial_actions.* → core/accounting_engine — balanced double-entry verified (dr==cr) across 50 recent entries.
✅ Reverse path: contra has source='reversal', reference_id='reversal::<orig>', original preserved (verified by direct DB read via /api/finance/journal-entries). Idempotent on repeat (tx_hash check).
✅ Four-Eyes enforced via JWT 'sub' (not body fields) — confirmed with 403 four_eyes_violation when مدير tries to approve own draft, and 200 committed when احمد1 (supervisor) approves.
⚠️ /api/assistant/chat 'executed' shape lacks approval_id — minor DX issue (clients currently must dig into cards[].data.approval_id).
